title: Conditions to check for Offline Access and Camera Upload

question.author: member_131
question.body: Could support clarify offline access and camera upload in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Mobile Apps documentation says: Camera upload sends new photos and videos from your device to the Camera Uploads folder automatically, in original quality. Camera uploads count against your storage quota and can be paused per network. Mark any file or folder as "Available offline" to pin a copy on the device; pinned items stay in sync over Wi-Fi by default. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
